listing.name: Bust A Groove 2 — BustAGroove2-Recomp (betinn)
listing.summary: The project describes a native desktop v1.3 build with HD textures. Portcove has not confirmed complete tracks or audio. Android Polygonia is a separate emulator-based version. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation USA SLUS-01159 CUE/BIN.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the desktop instructions with your own CUE/BIN. The local release/Jogar.bat or tools/recomp/build.ps1 -Step all route generates C code and 56 ahead-of-time overlays, then launches the native executable with --disc. Portcove has not inspected a ready-made public archive.

warnings: The project describes a native desktop v1.3 build with HD textures. Portcove has not confirmed complete tracks or audio. Android Polygonia is a separate emulator-based version.
